caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a dark brown or black silhouette of a whale, shown in profile facing right. The whale's body is textured with wood grain patterns, indicating it may represent a wooden model or carving. Its mouth contains several pointed, light-colored teeth visible at the edge, and there is a small circular eye. The whale's tail flukes are split, and a small, straight pole or stick extends downward from the underside of its belly near the middle, suggesting the object might be mounted on a stand. The background is plain and off-white, with some faint brownish stains or marks scattered across the paper. There appears to be some small, handwritten text and numbers at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Whale Weather Vane
